description: Sample business glossary for the Tru Secure CreDebit Dashboard. Used as a mock Alation glossary for pipeline testing without a live Alation instance.

terms.title: Compound Annual Growth Rate
terms.description: The compound annual growth rate (CAGR) measures the mean annual growth rate of premium revenue over a specified period, assuming profits are reinvested. Expressed as a percentage. A non-additive metric — must not be summed across segments.

terms.title: Annual Premium Growth
terms.description: The absolute change in total annual premium collected between the current and prior year. Used to track year-over-year revenue momentum across the insurance portfolio.

terms.title: Return on Investment
terms.description: The annualised return generated on insurance premiums relative to the initial investment or premium paid. Expressed as a ratio or percentage. Used to evaluate policy performance and profitability.

terms.title: Underwriting Expense
terms.description: The total costs incurred in the underwriting process, including risk assessment, policy issuance, and administrative overhead. A key input to loss ratio and profitability calculations.

terms.title: Total Annual Premium
terms.description: The aggregate annual premium collected from all active insurance policies in the portfolio. Represents gross written premium on an annualised basis before deductions.

terms.title: Total Premium Amount
terms.description: The total premium value associated with a policy or cohort of policies, covering the full policy term. Distinct from annual premium — includes multi-year policy value.

terms.title: Total Premium Paid
terms.description: The cumulative premium amount actually received from the policy holder up to the reporting date. Used to calculate outstanding liability and lapse risk.

terms.title: Total Premium Payable
terms.description: The total premium amount due from the policy holder over the entire policy term. Represents the contractual premium obligation regardless of payment status.

terms.title: Premium Payment Completion Rate
terms.description: The percentage of total payable premium that has been collected from the policy holder. Calculated as Total Premium Paid divided by Total Premium Payable. A key indicator of premium collection efficiency.

terms.title: Annual Growth Rate
terms.description: The fixed year-on-year growth rate of premium or investment return, used as a benchmark or assumption in actuarial and financial projections.

terms.title: Customer Identifier
terms.description: The unique identifier assigned to each insurance customer. Primary key of the customer dimension. Used to link policy records, claim records, and agent assignments to a single customer entity.

terms.title: Policy Holder Name
terms.description: The full legal name of the individual or entity that holds the insurance policy. Used for customer identification, communication, and reporting.

terms.title: Customer Gender
terms.description: The gender of the insurance customer as recorded at policy inception. Used for demographic segmentation and actuarial risk classification.

terms.title: Age at Policy Entry
terms.description: The age of the customer at the time the insurance policy was purchased. A key actuarial variable used in risk pricing and premium calculation.

terms.title: Customer Current Age
terms.description: The current age of the policy holder as of the reporting date. Derived or stored as a text field. Used in maturity and lapse risk analysis.

terms.title: Customer Occupation
terms.description: The declared occupation of the insurance customer. Used in underwriting risk assessment and customer segmentation for product targeting.

terms.title: Smoker Status
terms.description: Indicates whether the policy holder is a smoker or non-smoker at the time of policy application. Directly affects underwriting risk classification and premium pricing for life and health products.

terms.title: Medical Examination Required
terms.description: Indicates whether a medical examination was required as a condition of policy issuance. Stored as a text indicator. Used in underwriting workflow tracking.

terms.title: Customer Nationality
terms.description: The nationality of the insurance customer. Used for regulatory compliance, KYC classification, and geographic risk segmentation.

terms.title: State of Residence
terms.description: The Indian state in which the customer or agent is located. Used for geographic reporting, regulatory filing, and regional performance analysis.

terms.title: Insurance Agent Code
terms.description: The unique alphanumeric code identifying a licensed insurance sales agent. Primary key of the agent dimension. Used to attribute policies and commissions to the responsible agent.

terms.title: Sales Agent Name
terms.description: The full name of the insurance sales agent responsible for selling and servicing the policy. Used in agent performance reporting and customer service workflows.

terms.title: Agent Email Address
terms.description: The business email address of the insurance sales agent. Used for communication, identity verification, and system access management.

terms.title: Policy Plan Name
terms.description: The descriptive name of the insurance protection plan or product variant. Used to identify and categorise policy offerings in customer-facing and internal reporting.

terms.title: Policy Code
terms.description: The internal code identifying the insurance protection plan. Foreign key linking the policy fact table to the plan dimension. Used in product performance and mix analysis.

terms.title: Business Classification Code
terms.description: A code classifying the insurance business line or product category. Used for regulatory reporting, premium allocation, and portfolio segmentation.

terms.title: Policy Type
terms.description: The category or type of insurance policy (e.g., term, endowment, ULIP, whole life). Drives product-specific business rules for pricing, maturity, and claims.

terms.title: Policy Number
terms.description: The unique identifier for an individual insurance policy. Primary key of the policy fact table. Used to link all policy-level events — payments, claims, renewals — to a single policy record.

terms.title: Policy Start Date
terms.description: The date on which the insurance policy coverage began. Used for tenure calculation, anniversary tracking, and maturity date derivation.

terms.title: Last Premium Payment Date
terms.description: The date of the most recent premium payment received from the policy holder. Used to determine premium payment status, lapse risk, and outstanding balance.

terms.title: Policy Tenure
terms.description: The duration of the insurance policy in years, as agreed at inception. Determines the policy maturity date and the total premium payment schedule.

terms.title: Sum Assured
terms.description: The guaranteed amount payable to the beneficiary upon a claim event (death, maturity, or critical illness). Represents the maximum insurance coverage for the policy. Also referred to as Coverage Amount.

terms.title: Premium Amount
terms.description: The periodic premium amount due from the policy holder for maintaining insurance coverage. Can be monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual depending on the payment frequency.

terms.title: Premium Payment Frequency
terms.description: The frequency at which premium payments are collected from the policy holder — monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or annually. Affects cash flow projection and collection scheduling.

terms.title: Policy Loan Amount
terms.description: The maximum loan amount the policy holder is eligible to borrow against the surrender value of the insurance policy. A feature of participating and endowment policies.

terms.title: Policy Status
terms.description: The current status of the insurance policy (e.g., Active, Lapsed, Matured, Surrendered, Claimed). Central to portfolio health monitoring and regulatory reporting.

terms.title: Policy Maturity Amount
terms.description: The lump-sum amount payable to the policy holder upon the policy reaching its maturity date, assuming all premiums were paid and no claims were made during the term.

terms.title: Annualised Return on Investment
terms.description: The annualised rate of return on the investment component of an insurance policy, expressed as a percentage of the total premium paid. Used to benchmark policy performance against market alternatives.

terms.title: Policy Profit and Gain
terms.description: The net financial gain to the policy holder, calculated as the difference between the maturity or surrender value received and the total premiums paid. A key metric for policyholder value analysis.

terms.title: Regional Manager
terms.description: The name of the regional manager responsible for overseeing insurance sales and operations within a defined geographic region. Used for performance attribution and escalation routing.

terms.title: Zonal Manager
terms.description: The name of the zonal manager responsible for a group of regions within the insurance distribution hierarchy. Used for territory management and senior performance reporting.

terms.title: Sales Region
terms.description: The geographic sales region assigned to a policy, agent, or manager. Used for regional performance reporting, territory-based KPI tracking, and regulatory filings by geography.
